[SWS_CM_10443] Failures in sending of a SOME/IP request message
⌈
If the
sending of the SOME/IP request message fails locally (in a way which is notified
to the ara::com implementation), the ara::com implementation shall make the
Future returned by the Set or Get method of the respective Field class (see
[SWS_CM_00112] and [SWS_CM_00113]) ready according to [SWS_CM_10440].
⌋
